positioning.title: Automation & Solutions Architect
titleAlternatives: Solutions Architect · Automation, Enterprise Apps & AI
Enterprise Solutions Architect (Power Platform & AI Agents)
positioning.headline: I design and build the systems businesses run on: automations, enterprise apps, web platforms and AI agents.
positioning.tagline: Manual work in. Flows that run themselves out.

bio.short: Automation and solutions architect in Accra. I turn manual, email-and-spreadsheet processes into enterprise apps, automated workflows and AI-assisted systems for telecom, insurance, banking and healthcare.
bio.medium: I'm Larry Jay, an automation and solutions architect with 7+ years building production software across telecommunications, insurance, banking and healthcare. I design the whole system: the data model, the approval logic, the integrations and the interface people actually use. Today I build multi-country Power Platform solutions for a telecom group operating in nine markets. Before that I shipped Rails, .NET, Node and Python platforms, RPA for banking reconciliation, and AI-assisted tools for insurance and HR.
bio.long:
I'm Lawrence 'Larry Jay' Danso, an automation and solutions architect based in Accra, Ghana. For 7+ years I've built production systems for organisations where mistakes cost money: a telecom group running HR and payroll across nine countries, an insurer managing risk compliance, banks reconciling thousands of transactions a day, and health institutions handling patient records.

My work sits where process meets software. I map how a business actually runs, find the steps people repeat by hand, and replace them with systems that are auditable, role-secured and easy to use. That might be a Power Apps and Power Automate platform, a Rails or .NET application, a Python RPA bot, or an AI agent that routes and triages work.

I also take ownership beyond code. I've served as Associate Product Owner, gathered requirements with HR, Finance and executive stakeholders, run UAT across markets, and written the documentation and training that gets people to adopt what we ship. As lead developer at Bensy Legacy, I build web products for independent clients, from booking platforms to payment-enabled WordPress sites.

I'm currently deepening into agentic solutions on the Microsoft stack: Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry.
bio.aboutExtra: Outside work, I love sport and building communities.

projects.name: Probation Journey
projects.status: Live in production · post-launch support ongoing
projects.summary: A probation lifecycle platform that replaced email and spreadsheet tracking for new hires across nine operating companies.
projects.problem: Probation reviews ran on emails and spreadsheets. Milestones were missed, managers weren't reminded, and HR had no single view across countries with different probation lengths.
projects.solution: A Power Apps platform with separate employee, manager, HR and CHRO experiences. Cases are created automatically from Oracle HR headcount reports. Power Automate flows schedule milestone check-ins, send reminders, escalate overdue reviews and flag at-risk cases. One app handles 90-day and 180-day probation rules by country.

outcomes.label: roles with their own portal: employee, manager, HR, CHRO
manual case creation: cases are generated from HR headcount reports

highlights: Governance rules built in: managers can recommend Confirm or Extend; only HR and the CHRO can Terminate.
Item-level permissions on a single SharePoint site keep each country's records separate.
Automated SLA scanner, manager nudges and risk flagging on check-ins.
Audit log on every HR outcome.

projects.name: Lifestyle Benefit & Payroll Claims Portal
projects.status: Live in production · post-launch support ongoing
projects.summary: A claims platform where employees submit benefit claims and HR approves, tracks balances and releases payroll batches across five countries.
projects.problem: Benefit claims were submitted by email and tracked in spreadsheets, so balances drifted, approvals were slow and Finance had no single auditable record.
projects.solution: A Power Apps portal with two-stage HR approval, live gross and net balance tracking, and month-end payout batches. Power Automate owns every balance change so claims are never deducted twice. Country rules for tax, time zones and attachments are handled in one app.

outcomes.label: countries: Ghana, South Africa, Kenya, UAE and CAR
auditable record of every claim for Finance

highlights: Idempotent balance design that prevents double deductions.
Payout batches with paid-by, paid-on and batch reference audit fields, plus a guarded reversal flow.
Excel claim exports with attachments, emailed to HR on demand.
List-driven RBAC with four personas from approver to super admin.

projects.problem: Risk register breaches and policy issues were caught late through manual audit.
projects.solution: Built bots that monitor the risk register, issue policy alerts and flag breaches as they happen. Added features to the .NET 8 suite and connected it to Power Automate, Power Apps and Copilot.

outcomes.label: breach alerts instead of periodic manual audit
faster feature delivery from standardised integration patterns

highlights: Automated risk audit workflows for security best practice.
Standardised integration patterns across the Microsoft stack.
Internal developer tooling that raised sprint throughput.

projects.solution: Built reconciliation bots that match card and mobile money transactions and produce exception reports, automated client acquisition and onboarding steps, and built tooling that collates client data into analytics reports on schedule.
highlights: Reconciliation reports for VISA and mobile money transactions.
Automated client acquisition and onboarding workflow.
Scheduled collation of client analytics reports, replacing manual spreadsheet work.
Integrated with core banking APIs for account synchronisation.

OCR automation that reads client forms and onboards clients onto new insurance products.
Automation bots for heavy data processes in an isolated system.

projects.name: Enterprise Resume Screening System
projects.summary: Built at 4th-IR for HR teams: screens large volumes of applications against the APS resume standard and shortlists candidates with a trained model.
projects.problem: HR teams at client institutions checked every application by hand against a strict resume standard.
projects.solution: A Django and React platform that ingests applications in bulk, checks them against the standard, and uses an LLM to score and rank candidates for recruiters. I led product ownership and contributed to the architecture.
highlights: Led product ownership: requirements, documentation, resource allocation and go-to-market input from customer discovery.
Contributed to architecture and deployment.

projects.name: Hirivo (Resume Analyzer)
projects.summary: My own product for job seekers: scores a CV against a specific job post, flags ATS issues, and writes a tailored version as Word or PDF.
projects.problem: Job seekers send the same resume everywhere and can't see why it fails applicant tracking systems.
projects.solution: A Rails 8 API with an Angular front end. Uploaded CVs are parsed, analysed by an LLM in background jobs, checked for ATS problems, and rewritten into LaTeX-generated documents.
highlights: Background analysis and rewrite jobs with Sidekiq and Redis.
ATS detection and LaTeX-based DOCX/PDF generation.
JWT auth with TOTP two-factor and rate limiting.
Swagger-documented API and admin activity log.
